MOBILE BANKING ADOPTION AMONG RURAL WOMEN IN BANGLADESH

A thesis by Nusrat Jahan

SUMMARY

Mobile banking can widen financial inclusion, but rural women adopt it more slowly than men. Surveying 900 women in four districts, this thesis finds that agent proximity and phone ownership explain most of the gap.

7. Concluding remarks

Closing the gender gap in mobile banking needs more women agents and cheaper phones, not only financial literacy training.
